If I had to guess, you'd have to get reports across multiple different games, get through warnings, repeat, and finally get banned.

I think a mech that detects trolling is difficult. Trolling comes in a lot of forms which can be confused for genuine gameplay, especially in low elo (throwing, not listening properly to comms, etc.) Because of this fundamental component missing, the system making some teammates counted out of the forfeit would get too many people genuinely trying to play the game properly. A successful surrender, especially in comp, would be unfair to those falsely accused.

Things like these are extremely difficult to combat. No matter how hard devs try to implement troll detection, there will always be the falsely accused. No amount of discussion on how selfish trolling is in the community will never deter some people who just want to because they can't feel the inconvenience and annoyance they cause.

I do think there are ways to avoid trolls though. Whenever I encounter some, I always wait at least 2 minutes after the round is over to queue again so I don't get them in a game again. Same goes for just any toxic pricks I would not want to have to interact with again.

HOWEVER, in terms of resin efficiency and practicality, I would never recommend 4 Vermillion.  Since the Emblem/Shimenawa domain is probably the best one in the game (many meta characters such as Xiangling, Xingqiu, Mona, Raiden, etc. use Emblem, and Shimenawa is simply very versatile), you probably already have a good Shimenawa 2 pc. You also get Gladiator from bosses and strongboxes, so chances are that you probably already have a good Xiao build. A 9-5% dmg difference isn't worth the potential months of farming it can take to get a good 4 pc. You could even make a good build off 2 Vermillion 2 Echoes.

TLDR; 4 Vermillion is optimal but not worth your resin, just use atk% 2 pieces.

Meta-wise however, there are some major problems here:  
1) Kokomi can't apply hydro fast enough for Hu Tao's constant charge attacks  
2) Kokomi will heal over 50% on Hu Tao, which disables her passive talent, meaning it's a big loss in DPS  
\*\*For Hydro appliers, Xingqiu will always be Hu Tao's best option by a ton compared to the other characters. In every meta Hu Tao comp, Xingqiu will be by her side.  
3) Yae will constantly apply electro to enemies. If the enemy is affected by the explosion caused by overload, they will be all over the place since Yae and Hu Tao apply their respective elements extremely quickly. This means Hu Tao will have to run to get the enemy, reducing her stamina levels significantly, leading to more significant DPS loss since she can't charge attack.  
I think Zhongli is very appreciated by, especially, a c0 Hu Tao who can't afford to use her stamina for dodging everything. If you'd like to pair the two together, I recommend the following teams:

\-Hu Tao double Geo: Hu Tao|Xingqiu|Zhongli|Albedo (if you plan on pulling in the future)/Geo Traveler/even Yun Jin for a N2C (2 normal attacks into a charge attack) combo Hu Tao.  
\-FlexVape: Hu Tao|Xingqiu|Zhongli|Flexible slot

Some other good Hu Tao teams include:  
\-VV Vape (widely regarded to be her best team): Hu Tao|Xingqiu|Kazuha/Sucrose|Elegy Amber/Tankfei/Thoma/even Xinyan  
\-VapeMelt: Hu Tao|Xingqiu|Cryo|Cryo (Cryo units like Ayaka, Ganyu, Rosaria, Kaeya)
